what: FOLLICLE PALETTE + MAP for case cat1 (E6; Phase 2 Stage 5 spec, written 2026-10-18 by the hair builder). Each TYPE fully defines the hairs its follicles grow (shape, taper, length, crimp, stiffness, colour along the shaft). The MAP says which types grow where, at what density and in which direction. Editing a type changes every hair of that type at the next groom. Read by the Stage 5 groom (fur_plan.md); checked by C8 C9 C10 C13 C14.
status: SPEC (estimated). Nothing here is checked by a tool yet. Every value carries source + confidence (G2); evidence rank (G3): photo > constraints > Tripo/Phase 1 > cited anatomy > estimate.

map.how: Per skin point: type weights, total density, length scale, growth direction. Density is split over the follicle GROUP: per group 1 guard + ~2 awn + ~16 down (~19 hairs/group, LeRoy 2016 median 18.8 [A]; 2-5 primaries per group, Moriello/dvm360 [B]; S:P 10-15 adult, Ryder 1976 [B]). Type fractions of all hairs: guard 0.05, awn 0.11, down 0.84 (ESTIMATE within those sources; Noel & Hu 2018 'down hairs can outnumber guard hairs 24 to 1' [A] -> guard >= ~0.04).

group_spacing_mm.derivation: groups/mm2 = density / 19 -> 93/19 = 4.9 groups/mm2 on the back -> mean spacing 0.45 mm (Poisson-disk). The follicle group is the natural clump unit (cat-hair-streams.md (c), modelling suggestion)

density_basis.primary: coat.json density_per_cm2 (hepper popular article, 60,000/in2 back ~ 9,300/cm2, 120,000/in2 belly ~ 18,600/cm2) [C] - no cited per-area cat density exists (cat-hair-streams.md gap 4; searched again 2026-10-18: Noel & Hu 2018 SI Table S4 holds fur density for 2 cat species but the SI PDF is 403-blocked)
density_basis.independent_bracket: ESTIMATE cross-check from growth mass: Hendriks et al. 1997 mid-side growth 289 ug/cm2/day summer [A] / (0.30 mm/day growth, Baker 1974 [B] x keratin 1.3 g/cm3 x mean cross-section of the 0.05/0.11/0.84 mix with 47/30/15 um = 3.1e-6 cm2 -> 0.122 ug/day per growing hair) = 2,370 growing hairs/cm2; with an anagen fraction of 0.25-0.5 (ESTIMATE, unsourced) -> 4,700-9,500 hairs/cm2. Same order as the [C] value; supports it, does not prove it.

map.pigment_note: THE PHOTO DISAGREES WITH THE BRIEF'S 'points = mask, ears, legs/paws, tail': in ref.jpg all four legs and paws, the muzzle, chin, throat and chest are WHITE (lynx point with white - white spotting overrides the points there). Assignment per follicle comes from the Stage 4 photo projection (photo_markings), moved UPSTREAM along hair_dir by the visible offset (~L cos(lie)) so the colour seen at the tip lands on the right roots (groom.py samples at the tip for the same reason).

whiskers_mystacial_layout.spacing_note: 3-3.5 mm grid, ESTIMATE fitted inside the Phase 1 root spread
whiskers_mystacial_layout.length_source: PHOTO: longest visible whisker on the cat's right runs from the pad (~680,392) to a tip at (527,450) = 164 px = 61 mm PROJECTED (0.37 mm/px), a drooping one to (562,495) = 56 mm projected; cat's left longest tip (863,394) from ~(735,392) = 47 mm projected (more foreshortened: the head turns toward the image left).
